okLines: Fine. Running {{op}} from here. You owe me a Freddo.
{{op}}, coming down the line. Please don't make me do that again.
Typing {{op}}. My keyboard's sticky. Don't ask why.
{{op}}. Done. I think. The line went fuzzy for a second.
refusedLines: I tried. I got this back: {{reason}}

lines: Power's at {{power}}. Just saying. GEARGR~1.EXE is on your desktop and I can't reach the pedals.
Mainframe {{power}}. Could you go and drive for a bit? I'll hold the fort. The fort is a chair.
{{power}} and dropping. The generator needs you. I'd do it myself but I'm a terminal session.
brownoutLines: BROWNOUT. {{power}}. My line's all crackly and they've cut my remote access. Drive! Please!
{{power}}. I can still type but I can't touch anything. Clutch in, gear, clutch out. Go go go.
We're at {{power}}. If this goes dark it's the end of the shift. Ask me how I know.

lines: {{target}}? Neat. From where it is now: {{plan}}. Don't quote me.
Right, {{targetBits}}. Did it on a napkin: {{plan}}.
Still {{target}}? Then still: {{plan}}. I'm writing it on my hand.
currentLines: {{valueBits}}. Yeah, matches what I've got here. Now read me the TARGET row, the one underneath.
Current's {{value}}, agreed. The bottom row is the one I can't see. Lit is 1.
currentWrongLines: Hmm. I've got {{actualBits}} on my end, not {{valueBits}}. Are you reading the top row?
That's not what my terminal says. I see {{actualBits}}. One of us needs glasses.
wrongLines: {{valueBits}}? Nothing I can see is aiming for that. Read me the TARGET row again, left to right?
{{value}} doesn't ring a bell. Bottom row of the sector, lit is 1, dark is 0.
unknownLines: {{valueBits}}. Cool. Is that the CURRENT row or the TARGET row?
Top row or bottom row? I can't see your screen, remember.
stuckLines: {{target}}, got it. But from where you are there's no way there in the moves you've got left. Undo or reset, then ask me again.
You've painted yourself into a corner. Undo a few and tell me when.
doneLines: {{target}}? That one's already recovered. Look at you go.

lowLines: Power's at {{power}}. I can't drive, I'm on a terminal. You've got the clutch. GEARGR~1.EXE. Go.
{{power}}! The lights are doing the thing. Please go and drive the generator.
Mainframe at {{power}}. If it hits zero we both go home, and I don't think either of us gets paid.
lines: Mainframe's on {{power}}. Generator 2 tops it up, but only if somebody drives it. Somebody is you. I can't reach the pedals from here.
GEARGR~1.EXE. Clutch in, pick a gear, clutch out. Uphill wants a low gear, downhill wants a high one. Too low and it screams, too high and it bogs.
Keep the rev needle in the green band and it charges fastest. Space is the clutch. Left Shift down, Right Shift up. You can rebind them in the window.
Below 30% the line browns out and I can't touch your sectors. Below 15% Bit Rot won't run at all. At zero, lights out. Shift over.
Power's {{power}}. I'll nag. It's the one thing I'm good at.

topics.doneLine: BADGE.DB's recovered. No more sequences. Please. My brain is a screensaver.
lines: The sequence? You want me to do the thinking too? XOR before you shift. Everything's crooked until you do.
Try the big XOR, then the key. Then think about which way it needs to slide, and how far. Nibbles are four bits, by the way.
Fine. By type, from where you are now: {{opTypes}}. Which XOR is which is your problem.
Still {{opTypes}}, by type. If you read me the TARGET row in 1s and 0s I can be less vague.
stuckLines: From where you are? No way through in the moves you've got left. Undo or reset and ask again.
Out of road. Reset it. I won't tell Head Office.

topics.doneLine: TIMECLK.DAT's reconciled. I've read it. I wish I hadn't.
lines: The time clock? Nibbles again. It's all nibbles in this building.
Slide it, mask it, slide it back, then the override. Or some of that in some order. I'm guessing.
By type, from where you are: {{opTypes}}. Which XOR is which is your problem.
Still {{opTypes}}. Read me the TARGET row in 1s and 0s if you want it spelled out.
stuckLines: No way through from there in the moves you've got. Undo or reset, then ask.
That's a dead end. Reset it. The swipes won't mind.

lockedLines: I can't open SYSTEM files. I'm on PROBATION. Fix PAYROLL.DAT and maybe Head Office will trust me with more than a stapler.
Still PROBATION. PAYROLL.DAT first. That's literally what the README says.
Access denied. My badge says INTERN in a font that really means it.
topics.doneLine: BADGE.DB is already open. I'm choosing to take credit for that.
topics.unlockedLine: Key's in. You're welcome. Now it's just the order of the moves. Ask me about the sequence, or read me the TARGET row.
lines: What key? I'm an intern. I don't have keys. I have a lanyard.
There might be a log in a SYSTEM folder you can't see. Might. I'm not supposed to read it out.
It's NS-02.LOG. It says the key is 'read out per policy'. Nobody told me the policy. Ask again and I'll pretend I didn't hear.
Fine. FINE. It says: {{key}}. Hex, four digits. Type it into the key box on BADGE.DB and never tell Head Office.
I already told you: {{key}}. Hex. I'm writing it on my hand so one of us remembers.

lockedLines: The time clock's audit file is in SYSTEM. I'm still PROBATION. PAYROLL.DAT, please, then I can look.
Can't. PROBATION. Fix PAYROLL.DAT and Head Office will let me read the boring files.
topics.doneLine: TIMECLK.DAT is open. Two badges, one keyboard. Let's not talk about it.
topics.unlockedLine: Override's in. Now it's just the order. Ask me about the sequence, or read me the TARGET row.
lines: The time clock? It's got an override. Of course it has. Everything here has an override except my pay rate.
There's a TIMECLK.AUD in SYSTEM. OPERATOR eyes only. That's me now, apparently.
It says the override was run every night at 22:00 by #0117. Every night. Including tonight. I'm going to read it out before I lose my nerve.
Override key, read out per policy: {{key}}. Hex. Type it into the key box on TIMECLK.DAT. I need a lie down.
Still {{key}}. It hasn't changed. Nothing in this building changes.

topics.doneLine: GENSET.CFG's sorted. The generator still sounds like a sad cow, but a thriftier one.
lines: GENSET.CFG controls Generator 2. Governor's stuck at FULL, so it guzzles. Fix it and the mainframe drains slower.
No key on that one, just Bit Rot. Read me the TARGET row in 1s and 0s and I'll work out the order.
Someone reset that governor from NS-02. Which is this terminal. Which is weird.
SHIFTLOG.BAK? It's in C_DRIVE. Backups don't open. Says so right there.
It says the original SHIFTLOG.TXT is missing. Maybe it isn't missing. Maybe it's just wearing the wrong name.
Select it and press F2. Give it its name back: SHIFTLOG.TXT. Then tell me what it says. Actually, don't.

lockedLines: There's something SEALED in SYSTEM. SUPERVISOR only. I'm not a supervisor. I'm barely a person at this hour.
Sealed means sealed. Somebody would have to promote me again. TIMECLK.DAT maybe? Head Office loves a reconciled time clock.
lines: 0117.SEC. Personnel file. I'm a SUPERVISOR now, so I can read it. I'd rather not, but I have.
It says #0117 was terminated for 01:13 and 03:40. From terminal NS-02. And that the logs only name the terminal, not the person.
There's an audit at 06:00. Somebody's name goes in the report. I'd like it not to be mine. I'm new.
BLAME.EXE is at 97%. It's been at 97% for a while. Head Office software, so.
An audit at 06:00. Someone gets the blame for the 12th of October. I've only been here one night!
I'm not saying we should get our story straight. I'm saying it would be nice if we had a story.
I can't see your screen. I'm on the other terminal. Read me the TARGET row as 1s and 0s, left to right? Lit is 1.
If you type the lit squares as 1s and 0s I could do maths about it. Probably. I failed maths. Once.
Sixteen squares, sixteen 1s and 0s. Like 0000 1010 0000 0101. Not that one. Yours.
PAYROLL.DAT? Accounts said it's 'acting up'. Accounts says that about the kettle.
The hint says wipe, mask, nudge. I'd read that as three moves in some order. Very helpful of me.
Try the XOR early. Or late. I'm an intern, not a fortune teller. There's an Undo button for a reason.
I'm #0118. First night. They said #0117 would supervise me. Have you seen them? You're sitting at their desk.
#0117 was terminated last month according to payroll. But their badge swiped in at 22:00. So. That's fine. Totally fine.
I'd rather not talk about #0117. The lights flicker when I type it.
Have you tried turning it off and on again? Kidding. Open README.TXT.
Shift+click selects a range. F2 renames. Some backups only open if you give them the right name.
Corrupted files open in BITROT.EXE. Line the bits up. If a button says ????, it needs a key, and keys live in logs. Logs I can read. Hint hint.
Hey. Is it always this quiet? The generator keeps making a noise like a sad cow.
Hi again. Still here. Still on probation.
Yes, hello. We've met. You're the one at the haunted desk.
Sorry, was on smoko.
Hmm? I'll put that in a ticket.
Could you ask that as a question about keys, logs, power or #0117? I only did a six week course.
Noted. Filed. Lost. That's the ACME way.
My connection's dodgy. If you've got a real AI intern, plug it in. I'm just the scripted one.
